meta_description: OpenDrone pre-order rounds for EU pilots. Explore the batches and funding targets, or enquire about US retail distribution.
title: Pre-orders
targets_line: One order ships in one parcel. Want the stack in {month}? Order it separately.
faq_a_cancel: Any time before delivery. Full refund. [Withdrawal form](/en/herroepingsrecht#withdraw)
faq_a_missed: We email you a refund or a new date to accept. No reply within 30 days means cancellation and a refund within the following 14 days. You can also cancel before delivery.
faq_a_eta: New date by email. Cancel any time before delivery.
faq_a_shops: We are starting with EU consumer orders. US retailers can [request a bulk quote](/wholesale). Outside the EU, [get launch news](/newsletter); no consumer checkout is available.
$comment_updates: updates: "YYYY-MM-DD · text" strings, newest first. Never edit or delete an entry; add a new one.
intro: EU pilots first. Explore the batches below and choose your delivery country on the product page.
channel_eu_text: Buy directly from OpenDrone when orders open for your destination. Each batch has its own timing and funding conditions.
channel_us_text: Interested in stocking OpenDrone? Request a bulk quote. We will work with you on product eligibility, importing and delivery.
channel_interest: Outside the EU? Get launch news
